svg.aria-label: How the router evaluates routing rules: for each rule in order, check its match; if it holds, run its action: route or block decides, sniff fills the sniff result and goes on to the next rule; a request no rule decided takes default_action.
svg.title: How the router evaluates routing rules

g.text: The handler acts on the Decision
dials the outbound, or closes the stream
Different fields of a match must all hold; the values of one field are alternatives. An empty match holds for every request.
Domain fields read the sniffed name first, then the destination's domain. IP fields read a destination that is an IP: a domain is never resolved to match them.
route and block decide and end the list; sniff does not. A request no rule decided takes default_action.
